about: SW-S4: the rules a candidate model is judged by against the champion. Written down and agreed by the product owner and a clinician BEFORE the first contest (story NFR3), never changed after a run to suit its result. Nothing here was set by guess: every number is empty until it is agreed, and the contest refuses to start while the margin, the guarded metrics or the precision claim are missing.
margin_note: The largest drop allowed in any slice, as a fraction (0.01 = 1 point). The Accuracy Plan's forgetting guard assumes 1.0 point; the owner decides.
slice_metrics_note: The metrics guarded in EVERY slice, the first one deciding 'better overall'. Proposed, to agree: all.field_accuracy, then precision_accepted of patient, doctor, tests, preparation, and context prep_to_test.error_rate.

precision.note: Groups whose lower bound of accepted-value precision must not fall below the champion's; target 0.99 is the story's own, to confirm.

cost.note: per_hour is the rent of the one machine both models run on.
